regions.today: Mostly cloudy and dry this evening with only a few isolated showers and light southerly or variable winds.
regions.tonight: It will be largely cloudy tonight with some patchy mist and fog developing mainly in the south of the Province. Isolated drizzle is possible, but most places will stay dry. Mild and humid with lows of 13 to 16 degrees, with light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will start dry with some sunny spells, but it will become cloudy with spells of rain moving across the region during the afternoon. The rain will be heavy at times. Warm and humid with highs of 18 to 24 degrees, with light to moderate southerly winds at first, increasing moderate to fresh through the day.
regions.solar_uv: Generally low, but moderate in any sunny spells.
